in_marathi.name: Radhamani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radhamani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Radhamani means 'Radiant Goddess' in Sanskrit and Hindi. This name is derived from the name of Lord Krishna's beloved, Radha. Radha is considered the embodiment of love and devotion, and her name is often used as a term of endearment for the divine. Radhamani is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
